# Fullscape v1.4.1

- Adds **Font and Weight** settings for Fullscape. Choose the language-aware default or serif preset, enter the name of an installed font, and adjust the weight independently. Changes apply to lyrics, track details, and the queue immediately.
- Improves how Fullscape chooses between cached lyrics and Apple Music lyrics, and respects manual source selections synced from LyricShiori.

## Install or update

Download `fullscape.js`, copy it to your Spicetify Extensions directory, then run the following commands.

```sh
spicetify config extensions fullscape.js
spicetify apply
```

Existing Fullscape installations can also select this release through the built-in update settings. The release includes `fullscape.js.sha256` for checksum verification.
